title: EmphAssess : a Prosodic Benchmark on Assessing Emphasis Transfer in Speech-to-Speech Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using string-identical sentences with differing emphasis positions to evaluate whether models genuinely transfer prosodic emphasis or merely exhibit a built-in preference for emphasizing specific words or sequence positions.

Comparing the emphasis classifier's performance (F1 score, precision, and recall) across multiple languages (English, Spanish, Vietnamese, Italian, French, Portuguese) to assess performance disparities, training language preference, and cross-lingual generalization.
